method: Every non-reprint card from Lorwyn Eclipsed through Reality Fracture (and their Commander decks) was checked against the 20 most recently updated Bracket 2-3 Sokka decks on Moxfield and EDHREC's Sokka pages, then filtered for noncreature spells and Ally tokens. Game Changers excluded.
summary: Sokka makes an Ally for every noncreature spell, so the best new cards make spells cheaper (Geist of Saint Thalia) or turn each spell into more value (Vraska, Mister Fantastic). The badge on each card counts the sources that include it; "Claude's pick" means no list runs it yet.

sets.name: EDHREC Recommendations
sets.note: Cards Sokka players commonly run in Bracket 2 and 3 that aren't in your deck, from EDHREC's bracket pages and average decks. Game Changers removed (Fierce Guardianship, Teferi's Protection, Cyclonic Rift, Mystical Tutor, Enlightened Tutor, Jeska's Will, Farewell, Rhystic Study, Smothering Tithe). Sorted by how often they're played.

picks.name: Geist of Saint Thalia
picks.why: Two-mana flyer that makes every noncreature spell cost one less, so you cast more spells and make more Ally tokens each turn.

sources.label: Moxfield: 3 of 20 recent Bracket 2-3 Sokka lists

picks.name: Vraska, Soul of Stone
picks.why: Every noncreature spell also makes a Treasure creature token, so each spell gives you two bodies (an Ally and a Sculpture) and the mana to keep going.

sources.label: Moxfield: 2 of 20 recent Bracket 2-3 Sokka lists

picks.name: Twinned Vision
picks.why: Instant draw with flashback, so two noncreature casts and two Ally tokens from one card.

sources.label: Moxfield: 2 of 20 recent Bracket 2-3 Sokka lists

picks.name: Ajani's Anguish
picks.why: Removal or a burn finisher, and it gives your wide board of Ally tokens trample.

sources.label: Moxfield: 3 of 20 recent Bracket 2-3 Sokka lists

picks.cutWhy: Anguish is removal and a finisher in one

picks.name: Mister Fantastic, Reed Richards
picks.why: Draws a card whenever tokens enter, and Sokka makes a token with every noncreature spell. That turns each spell into a cantrip.

sources.label: Moxfield: 2 of 20 recent Bracket 2-3 Sokka lists

picks.name: Pym Particles
picks.why: One-mana cantrip that makes a creature unblockable. It makes an Ally and pushes damage through.
